_about: Expected search answers for tests/run-checks.js. exact: the answer line (and its note, links' text) word for word - questions whose answer can only change when a season ends (a past season, an all-time record over finished seasons). When one changes on purpose - a reworded answer, a record broken at a season's end - run `npm run check:update` and commit the new text with the change. shape: questions touching the current season, whose numbers move with each sync - a pattern (JavaScript regex) the answer must match. phone: true runs it on the Mobile page.
